record_type_quote: Researchers aimed to replicate and extend previous findings on the impact on and experiences of LEOs participating in an autism training that included virtual reality (VR) simulation.

targets.title: Training law enforcement officers about autism: Evaluation of adding virtual reality or simulation to a traditional training approach
targets.evidence_quote: The present study aimed to build upon Gardner and Campbell’s (2025) findings by replicating and extending the evaluation of VR simulation training for LEOs responding to autism-related calls.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract gives confidence gains in this sample, but the available preview stops at “Previous results” before describing the original result or its comparison. No self-contained overall replication verdict is supplied; positive present results alone do not settle agreement.
